name: Fatty Acid Oxidation and Ketogenesis Disorder with Dilated Cardiomyopathy
aliases: FAO and Ketogenesis Defect with Cardiomyopathy
Inherited Fatty Acid Metabolism Disorder with Dilated Cardiomyopathy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Fatty Acid Oxidation Disorders with Cardiomyopathy

criteria.description: Presence of dilated cardiomyopathy with signs of cardiac failure in infancy or early childhood
Abnormal plasma acylcarnitine profile indicating impaired fatty acid oxidation and ketogenesis
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes involved in fatty acid oxidation or ketogenesis pathways
Episodes of hypoketotic hypoglycemia during metabolic stress
Histological or enzymatic evidence of fatty acid oxidation defect in muscle tissue

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of dilated cardiomyopathy with biochemical evidence of fatty acid oxidation defect and confirmation by genetic testing
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is supported by clinical, biochemical, and genetic findings; muscle biopsy is optional.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Dilated cardiomyopathy with congestive heart failure
pathognomonic.notes: Typically presents in infancy or early childhood
searchTerms: heart muscle disease with heart failure
low sugar levels in blood stress

common.notes: Due to fatty infiltration or metabolic stress

common.symptomName: Lethargy and poor feeding in infancy

rare.notes: Due to severe cardiomyopathy or arrhythmia

searchTerms: low blood pressure during metabolic crises

laboratory: Elevated plasma acylcarnitines indicative of fatty acid oxidation defects
Hypoketotic hypoglycemia during fasting or illness
Increased creatine kinase during rhabdomyolysis episodes
imaging: Echocardiography showing dilated cardiomyopathy with reduced ejection fraction
Cardiac MRI confirming myocardial dilation and fibrosis
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes such as ACADVL, HADHA, HADHB, or HMGCS2
other: Muscle biopsy showing lipid accumulation and deficient fatty acid oxidation enzyme activity

distinguishingFeatures: Negative fatty acid oxidation enzyme assays
Multisystem involvement beyond fatty acid metabolism

redFlags: Early onset dilated cardiomyopathy with metabolic crises
Hypoketotic hypoglycemia during fasting or illness
Rapid progression to heart failure or sudden cardiac death
references: Roe CR, et al. Fatty acid oxidation disorders and cardiomyopathy. J Inherit Metab Dis. 2019;42(5):1003-1015.
Orphanet: Fatty acid oxidation and ketogenesis disorder with dilated cardiomyopathy. ORPHA:217616.
Spiekerkoetter U, et al. Clinical and biochemical features of fatty acid oxidation disorders. Mol Genet Metab. 2020;130(1):1-10.
